items.summary: A new study suggests that the flowers adorning Benvenuto Cellini's sculpture Narcissus are more than decoration: they connect the development of botanical science with competition among Renaissance artists and the ambition of Florence's ruler to consolidate his status.

items.title: Lijekovi poput Ozempica mogli bi poboljšati kvalitetu sperme, pokazuje studija
items.summary: NOVA studija ukazuje da bi lijekovi poput Ozempica, osim za dijabetes i mršavljenje, mogli poboljšati i mušku plodnost. Zabilježen je porast koncentracije spermija i razine testosterona.
